patterns.notes: js-yaml 3.14.2 and 4.1.1 fix prototype pollution in merge operation. Upgrade is non-breaking for 3.x users.
alternative_mitigations: Use Deno (pollution protection on by default)
patterns.dependency_analysis: Often transitive via gatsby, eslint, gray-matter, gatsby-plugin-mdx

steps: Resolve file path to absolute path (follows symlinks)
Resolve allowed directory to absolute path
Check if file path is relative to allowed directory
Raise ValueError if path is outside directory

patterns.notes: Defense-in-depth path validation prevents both direct path traversal and symlink-based attacks. Always validate AFTER path construction but BEFORE file operations.
alternative_mitigations: Use os.path.commonpath() to verify paths share common base
Whitelist allowed filenames instead of constructing paths
Use chroot jails to sandbox file access
best_practices: Add comprehensive tests for symlink attacks
Log failed validation attempts for monitoring

patterns.notes: Replace MD5 with SHA-256 for all hashing operations, even non-security-critical ones like cache keys. SHA-256 is more collision-resistant and aligns with modern security standards.
patterns.breaking_change_details: Cache keys will change, invalidating existing cache entries. Plan cache invalidation during deployment.
